beats: Cast rule (episodes/e01-moe/FACTS.md: an expert is not a topic specialist; never label one by subject): the receptionist plus eight doctors told apart only by face and hair, no specialty props; the film numbers the doors in code (#0-#255), never names a department.

Hook: DeepSeek-V3 decodes on 320 GPUs, and 256 of them each hold a single expert: a dollhouse building of tiny rooms, one doctor per room (line_moe_room_grid); 40 nodes of 8 GPUs as a campus of 40 small buildings (line_moe_campus_grid).

An MoE layer is a set of isolated experts. The dense way (tensor parallelism) splits one patient between four doctors who must then pool their notes (the AllReduce: line_moe_split_patient; or L04-04's line_allreduce_desk_circle from the library); expert parallelism gives every expert its own room and no meeting (line_moe_own_rooms).

The bills: two all-to-alls per layer, dispatch and combine: patients cross between every pair of buildings and back (line_moe_shuttle_crisscross); and uneven load: in a DeepSeek layer the busiest expert gets 15-20x the average, and everyone waits for it (line_moe_one_long_queue).

The real layout: data/tensor parallel attention, expert-parallel experts. DeepSeek-V3 on H800s (NVLink 160 GB/s vs 450 GB/s on H100): prefill on 4 nodes / 32 GPUs (EP32), decode on 40 nodes / 320 GPUs (EP320): 256 rooms for the routed experts, 64 for the shared expert and the spares (line_moe_spare_rooms; reuse line_servers, line_gpu).

Balance (EPLB): copy the hot expert into a spare room (line_moe_twin_doctors), re-planned every few minutes from recent traffic, because people at the same hour ask similar things: at midnight the waiting room is all students with code due (line_moe_midnight_waiting_room; reuse line_clock_face, line_tally_pages).
Fewer trips: each token may use experts on at most 4 nodes (draw the route over line_moe_campus_grid); the lab's own profiling (arXiv 2510.05497) saw this as square patterns.

Two hops: one slow bus between buildings over InfiniBand (about 50 GB/s), then a fast walkway inside over NVLink (160 GB/s): 3.2x faster, so about 3.2 experts per node ride free, 3.2 x 4 = about 13 per token in theory (line_moe_bus_then_walkway).
Takeaway + cliffhanger: attention and experts share the same GPUs; is that wise? (tease L14-04 with line_moe_decode_cutaway from its plan).
